description.narrative: OVOF will use capacity-building and convenings among feminist movements to strengthenand build movements within countries and across regions, while also link feminist movementsto relevant actors, such as internet rights’ movements, Dutch allies and progressivepolicymakers. OVOF believes in strengthening movements from within, to create moreinclusive, powerful and resilient movements. To influence laws and policies at national andinternational levels, OVOF sees this as the only sustainable mitigation strategy in relation tothe increasing power of anti-rights and anti-gender forces.

comment.narrative: As the indicator measures any new values occurring since the start of the intervention,the baseline value is set at 0. It will take some time to identify if tech solutions will be meaningful as an intervention in the countries.

Though there was no target, the partners were keen to create more spaces to engage with their communities as the project is coming to a conclusion soon. There was also more interest around technology related conversations and skill building due to the political turmoil and internet shutdown which took place during the protests last year. Since it is the last year of OVOF, partners also tried their best to create as many spaces as possible as possible during the implementation period.
